decision: Prepare this combined refinement from geometric CK1000 only; no automatic follow-up beyond1000 updates.

source.verification_scope: Read saved CPU tensors/config and installed runner source only; no model instantiation, simulator, forward, RNG draw, optimizer update or complete state-equivalence rerun. Existing finalize_runner_loading will verify loaded state exactly before any future update.

objective_definition.error: Requested minus actual authored-base-origin body vx/vy/angular-z, including zero cross axes.
objective_definition.weighting: Rate times dt exactly once; termination remains a discrete -5 event.
objective_definition.meaning: Scalar rewards and advantages in PPO; no differentiating through robot dynamics. Continuous cusp is intentional.

tracking_calibration.mode: Offline rescoring of the same retained states; no new policy rollout or predicted learning outcome.

formulas.per_tick: weighted rate * dt; positive reported costs subtract from reward

checks: zero requested-axis cost and sign symmetry
monotone error costs and retained large-error broad sensitivity
old/new precision equality at two precision scales
exactly one dt factor in reported per-tick contributions

limitations: The precision cost has a cusp at exactly zero; old local cost is quadratic and new local cost is approximately linear.
New precision is larger for 0<abs(error)<0.06 and smaller above 0.06; both are bounded by beta. The broad term retains acquisition sensitivity.
Costs use requested minus actual body velocities on all axes, including zero cross axes. Body angular-z is not Euler heading rate during tilt.
These fixed-state costs are not policy gradients, evidence of causal objective conflict, or a prediction of improvements.
Stronger near-zero cost may penalize noise/oscillation and compete with support or corrective motion; no new rollout tests that tradeoff here.
This package changes a reward shape and two scales together; it is not an isolated causal ablation.

clearance_and_angular_calibration.calibration_scope: Frozen retained states only; no rollout or prediction of learned behavior.

definitions.angular: Body wx^2+wy^2 in (rad/s)^2, including both bias and oscillation. No yaw penalty.
definitions.clearance: Mean over all four wheels of Huber((collision-cylinder gap−same desired gap)/.04 m); no load escape gate.
definitions.counterfactual: Only the named gap or velocity is replaced; other frozen quantities need not be physically self-consistent.
definitions.reward_subset: Descriptive saved-state rate subset; not total return. Missing limit, wheel-zero and discrete termination costs are not reconstructed.
definitions.termination: Existing discrete termination−5. Incremental-cost equivalent time ignores continuing reward, resets and future state; not a reset-seeking prediction.
definitions.per_wheel: Quarter contribution is conditional mean divided by4; all-window contribution additionally includes that phase fraction.

clearance_and_angular_calibration.validation: Every retained window: exact2x rate rescore and per-tick=rate*saved dt once.

coefficient_recommendation.rationale: The proposed pair is modest against retained tracking rates, increases the weak-apex penalty without changing phase shape/apex, and targets measured roll/pitch rates separately from cancellation-sensitive net camera velocity.
limitations: Cost calibration is not a gradient or a learning-effectiveness result.
No claim that angular damping improves net camera RMS: negative translation/rotation covariance can change.
Greater clearance weight can increase base heave or tracking compromises; weaker rear swing remains unloaded/early without apex clipping.
Observed-state rates do not prove absence of stall or reset-seeking behavior in training; unobserved extreme states and future visitation are unknown.

observed_state_risk_check.mode: Offline complete reward reconstruction and instantaneous stopped-body velocity counterfactual

definitions.new_total_rate: Sum of all22 continuous active reward rates with the proposed precision kernel, clearance−2 and angular−.15; termination stays separate and is zero on all retained traces.
definitions.stopped_body: Replace only measured vx/vy/body-wz with zero in tracking. Preserve command, phase, anchor/error state and all other recorded costs.
definitions.optimistic_stopped: Additionally set clearance and ang_vel_xy costs to zero. This overstates the savings from those two costs; it is not a physically realizable frozen rollout.
definitions.stall_margin: Observed new total minus optimistic stopped total, same recorded task state; positive prefers observed useful motion in this conditional comparison.
definitions.one_second: Sliding50sample arithmetic mean rate; acquisition is the first50 samples of the command window.

checks: all23 saved active reward names covered
no terminal events in retained cases
package change agrees with separate tracking calibration to1e−7

limitations: Raw summed rewards are not recorded, so total is reconstructed from trace fields and existing formula helpers rather than compared against a saved runtime reward buffer.
The counterfactual does not simulate physically stopping, changing support, camera motion, pose, effort or future path evolution. It is an instantaneous conditional check.
Stand and complete-stop windows intentionally request zero velocity; slowing at those times is correct, so no positive useful-motion margin is required there.
Acquisition starts near rest, so individual near-zero/negative margins at early ticks do not establish a stall policy incentive; report actual1s windows and ongoing movement separately.
A30s added-cost integral exceeding the discrete−5 termination cost cannot establish reset seeking or rule it out. Reset changes future rewards, geometry, command, episode accounting and state.
No reset/failure-association records or new policy rollout are available to estimate changed-objective failure probability or deliberate reset behavior.
Cost differences and reward-rate distributions are not policy gradients, returns after learning or evidence that the refinement will improve physical performance.

smoke.limitation: Execution/state validation only; smoke is not a production initializer or policy-quality result.

production.initialization: Full native actor/critic/normalizers/learned std/Adam/LR/iteration; not simulator/RNG continuation. Never use smoke checkpoint.
production.critic: Initially estimates the old objective and must adapt. Initial value-loss changes alone do not imply failure.

future_selection.conditions: Actor mean, saved nominal dynamics, no noise/DR/push/controller changes; same reset/phase conventions; primary50Hz.
future_selection.maximum_intermediate: One on a relevant regression only
priority: Requested speed AND heading/path; body angular-z is not Euler yaw rate.
Per-wheel clearance, unloading, recontacts, contacts and saturation.
Base heave and roll/pitch rates; camera translation/rotation/cross term separately.

frozen_targets.retained_stop_reference: CK499 endpoint/path.0311/.1051m, lateXY.00544m/s; retain all previous guide requirements and source comparisons, not universal certification.

future_selection.limits: No slower travel to claim less drift. No worse holding/stopping or camera motion accepted as a stepping win. No ranking raw returns across objectives.
future_selection.after_failure: Report the remaining limitation; no automatic weight change or extension. Actor still lacks accumulated path error/history.
